1) Serum iron and copper are elevated in patients with HCC compared to controls, 2) The levels of serum iron and copper are higher in patients with HCV-related HCC compared to patients with HBV-related HCC, 3) The levels of iron and copper are lower in HCC patients with PCT than in patients with HHC and 4) Serum iron and serum copper are independent risk factors for the development of HCC.

(i) iron overload in PCT is not associated with increased risk of HCC development; (ii) iron overload in HC is associated with increased risk; and (iii) the risk is increased only when iron overload is associated with liver damage.
